validation.intervals: The paired difference interval endpoints are divided by the observed simulation mean. These are descriptive normalized difference intervals, not confidence intervals for a ratio with an estimated denominator.
validation.protocol: Six matched initial states, 16 continuations per state, 42 parameter combinations, t=5,10,20,30.

higher_order.absolute_interval: Pointwise paired percentile bootstrap of the mean difference across 130 initial states.
higher_order.relative_interval: Existing ratio-bootstrap intervals retained unchanged from Fig2_f_higher_order.csv.
higher_order.units: Gini for G; probability for M. Multiply M values by 100 for percentage points.
